name: Rapid Capture & Triage
purpose: Convert fast, chaotic voice-note/text capture into structured project/process/task/idea/backlog/supervision/doubt updates while preserving ambiguity and minimizing formatting work.
triggers: user dictates or dumps many updates quickly
task/project priorities need reconciling from natural language against a known snapshot
a preview is needed before writing to a JSON/PM-tool update
notes-app-speed capture must become structured input for another system
non_triggers: long-term canonical synthesis across historical files/decisions
inventing a priority, project assignment, owner, or due date not stated or implied
auditing an existing product/process for quality
quality_gates: no silent deletion of an unmentioned item
recurrent vs. supervision are never conflated
duplicate detection is actually performed whenever a snapshot is supplied
every genuine ambiguity in the source capture survives into AMBIGUITIES.md
stop_conditions: all four required artifacts produced and consistency check passes -> COMPLETE
capture usable but part unclassifiable given supplied context -> PARTIAL, state what input is needed
no usable raw capture supplied -> BLOCKED
never emit a delta that disagrees with its own preview, never present a genuinely ambiguous fragment as confidently classified
